_readme: Enemies on a map, and every way an enemy record can be wrong. It ships deliberate faults - 'nowhere' stands outside the map, 'nameless' names no EnemyDef, and 'giver' collides with the object id above it - so problems() has something to find here; do not use this file where an empty problems() is the assertion. The 'lurker' at [3,3] is the only clean one, and the only EnemyDef named that nothing else in the fixtures names.
